verdicts.reason: Both 320x50 banners follow the same left-to-right order (can, wordmark and headline, pills, body copy, CTA). In both, the body copy next to the pills is too small to read. The can is shrunk to a speck and loses its circle backdrop. The pills crowd the headline baseline, and the CTA is jammed against the right edge. B is slightly worse: a stray piece of the green circle sits on the right edge, colliding with and cluttering the CTA. A is cleaner but has the same unreadable-text problem.
